tabs.one: Fifteen-year-old Vaibhav Sooryavanshi smashes a record-breaking 204 off 53 balls with 28 sixes as India A defeats UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars .
tabs.html:
Results & scores

  • ACC Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 (Group B): India A 254/3 beat UAE A 254 (losing target adjusted) by 7 wickets; standout performance: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi scored 204 off 53 balls (fastest List A century in 28 balls and double hundred in 52/53 balls, hitting 28 sixes).
  • Women's Emerging Nations Trophy: Sri Lanka beat Ireland to win the title, starred by Imesha Dulani and Sathya Sandeepani.
  • Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Delhi defeated Tamil Nadu by a massive margin, powered by Priyansh Arya's record 181; Bengal beat Uttar Pradesh by 93 runs; Mumbai, Vidarbha, Andhra, Kerala, and Baroda also secured wins in their respective matches.
  • Test Match (1st Test): India vs New Zealand ended in a draw, featuring strong batting performances from Rishabh Pant, Shubman Gill, KL Rahul, and Yashasvi Jaiswal.
  • Test Match (2nd Test, Centurion): South Africa took a mammoth 403-run lead over Bangladesh on Day 2, driven by centuries from Marques Ackerman and Wiaan Mulder. 111

The big stories

  • Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's Historic Knock: Fifteen-year-old Indian prodigy Vaibhav Sooryavanshi shattered multiple world records by scoring 204 off 53 balls against UAE A, recording the fastest List A century (28 balls) and double century (52 balls) alongside 28 sixes, drawing universal acclaim and a credited 30-minute prep call from Yuvraj Singh.
  • IPL 2027 Auction Registrations: A total of 1,220 players have registered for the upcoming IPL 2027 mini-auction in Goa, featuring 939 Indians and 281 overseas players, with former England captain Ben Stokes entering at the ₹2 crore base price.
  • ICC Test Rankings Updates: Following the first Test against New Zealand, Jasprit Bumrah moved up to joint-second in the bowling rankings, while Indian batters Rishabh Pant, Shubman Gill, and Yashasvi Jaiswal climbed into the top 10.
  • Domestic T20 Records: Delhi opener Priyansh Arya smashed the highest individual T20 score by an Indian with a blistering 181 in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, equalling the record for most sixes in a T20 innings.
  • Coaching & Management Changes: Paras Mhambrey has joined the Punjab Kings as their fast bowling coach, reuniting with head coach Ricky Ponting ahead of the upcoming IPL season.
  • Controversies & Discussions: BCCI Vice-President Rajeev Shukla dismissed political rows surrounding Mohammed Siraj's exclusion from the playing XI, urging that the matter not be blown out of proportion.

Coming up

  • India tour of New Zealand: 2nd Test match scheduled at Hagley Oval, Christchurch.
  • ACC Asia Cup Rising Stars: Sri Lanka A vs India A Semi-Final in Doha.
